# Every floor requirements.txt declares, as an exact pin. The `floors` job in
# .github/workflows/tests.yml installs requirements.txt under this file as a
# pip constraint and runs the suite there, so each `>=` line is a release
# something installs. Locally, in a new Python 3.11 virtual environment:
#
#   pip install -r requirements.txt -c .github/floors.txt
#
# One line per requirement, the version written as requirements.txt writes
# it. tests/test_requirements.py::TestTheFloorsAreExercised fails when a line
# here and its line there disagree, or when either has one the other lacks.
# Moving a floor is CI.md's "Every floor is run, not just declared".
PySide6==6.8.1
PyMuPDF==1.25.4
openpyxl==3.1
python-docx==1.1
pdf2docx==0.5.8
pytesseract==0.3.10
Pillow==10.0
anthropic==0.40
PyYAML==6.0
